# No Base. No Season.

> A 5 week gym and rugby programme for players aged 13 to 19, run by Strong & Courageous Rugby at Goliath Fit for Purpose gym, Unit 16B, Fish Eagle Park, Kommetjie Road, Cape Town, South Africa. 5 November to 5 December 2026. 10 sessions. 15 spots. R1 500.

## Key facts

- Who: rugby players aged 13 to 19. Any position, club, school or level. No gym experience needed.
- When: Thursdays 6 PM to 7:30 PM (gym session) and Saturdays 8 AM to 10 AM (gym and rugby basics), 5 Nov to 5 Dec 2026.
- Where: Goliath Fit for Purpose, Unit 16B, Fish Eagle Park, Kommetjie Road, Cape Town.
- Cost: R1 500 for all 10 sessions, paid once via PayFast after the sign up form.
- Group size: 15 players, one head coach.
- Head coach: Jonathan Raphael. World Rugby Level 2, BokSmart accredited, B.Ed, First Aid and CPR. 20 years of coaching in South Africa and the Netherlands, including Western Province Rugby Academy (strength, conditioning and analysis, 2014 to 2017) and Head of Rugby at Sun Valley Primary School (2018 to 2022).
- Gym content: squat, hinge, press and pull from an empty bar; trunk and neck strength for contact; sprint mechanics, change of direction and landing; rugby specific conditioning.
- Rugby content: catch and pass under pressure, safe tackle technique, breakdown basics, game understanding.
- Contact: WhatsApp or call 083 705 6605 (+27 83 705 6605), email jonathan@1vnine.com.
